verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party usage or adoption analytics for a Linear workspace. Customer-request filtering ([linear-docs-8]) analyzes customer feedback, not product adoption. The GraphQL API ([linear-docs-16]) is only a developer building block from which such analytics could be constructed, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can retrieve usage analytics to understand how the product is adopted across my workspace
